actions-list.actionItem: Pursuant to the order of Thursday, November 12, 2026,  the Journal of the proceedings of the Senate was deemed approved to date.
Pursuant to the order of Thursday, November 12, 2026, the morning hour being deemed expired, and the times for the recognition of the two leaders being reserved.
The following transactions of morning business occurred on today.

H.R. 2302 (Rep. McClintock):
        A bill to take certain Federal land in the State of California into trust for the benefit of the Shingle Springs Band of Miwok Indians, and for other purposes.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.


 H.R. 2347 (Rep. Smucker):
        A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exclude from gross income any damages, other than punitive damages, received on account of any sexual acts or sexual contact.

        -- Motion by Senator Thune to commit to Senate Committee on Finance with instructions to report back forthwith with the following amendment (SA 6888) fell when cloture was invoked on amendment SA 6883 in Senate.

        -- Considered by Senate.
 

 S.Amdt. 6883 (Sen. Capito):
        In the nature of a substitute.

        --Cloture on amendment SA 6883 invoked in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 70 - 27.Record Vote Number: 264


        --Considered by Senate.


 S.Amdt. 6884 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --Considered by Senate.


 S.Amdt. 6885 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --Considered by Senate.


 S.Amdt. 6886 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --Considered by Senate.


 S.Amdt. 6887 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --Considered by Senate.


 S.Amdt. 6888 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --SA 6888 (the instructions of the motion to commit) fell when cloture invoked on amendment SA 6883.


 S.Amdt. 6889 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --SA 6889 fell when SA 6888 (the instructions of the motion to commit) fell.


 S.Amdt. 6890 (Sen. Thune):
        To improve the bill.

        --SA 6890 fell when SA 6889 fell.




 H.R. 7834 (Rep. Lee):
        A bill to limit liability for certain entities storing child sexual abuse material for law enforcement agencies, and for other purposes.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.


 S. 3296 (Sen. Collins):
        A bill to amend chapter 81 of title 5, United States Code, to cover, for purposes of workers' compensation under such chapter, services by physician assistants and nurse practitioners provided to injured Federal workers, and for other purposes.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Unanimous Consent.

PN999-2:
        Daniel Desmond Domenico, of Colorado, to be UnitedStates Circuit Judge for the Tenth Circuit

        -- Considered by Senate.

        -- Confirmed by the Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 51 - 46. Record Vote Number: 263
Under the authority of the order of today, at  7:25 p.m, the Presiding Officer (Mr. Husted in the chair) declared the Senate adjourned, under its order of today, until 10 a.m. tomorrow.
